note:
R125 - gen7 goalie gear: database value -> asset file position (prompt research-20260926-after-receipt3, package 4). Read-only.
Sources: Xbox 360 NHL 08 (member names of `data0.big` / `data1.big`, BIG4, via the 2026-09-18 big4_list parser) and the loose trees of
NHL 09 -> Legacy (R53 roots) + PS3 NHL 15 / Legacy. Families under `rendering/`: goaliehelmet (mask shells / paints, cage, throat
protector, helmet), goaliepad, blocker, trapper, goaliestick (+ `fe*` twins where present). Every file stem is split into its prefix and
numeric groups (`<prefix>_<n1>_<n2>..._<kind>`).
Per title and goalie-equipment DB column (`exhibitiongoalieequipment`: masktype, maskid, maskpattern, maskrank, pads, blocker, trapper,
stick, neckprotector): the column's value set, and for every (family prefix, numeric position) the share of those values found at that
position and the size of that position's value set. A position that contains every DB value is a CANDIDATE binding; several such positions
= ambiguous (small ids fit many ranges). Also per title: for blocker / trapper, how many ids exist under both n1 = 0 and n1 = 1.
Containment is naming evidence only: it does not show which file the game draws.
Usage: python r125_gen7_goalie_gear_chain.py <r53.json> <out.json>
